annotation.bound_parties_text: The excerpt names no bound parties; it describes principles and guidance for remote support of automated driving systems.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: The principles are written generally to support system development and provide guidance on how to evaluate human-automation-environment system performance
annotation.legal_effect_quote: The principles are written generally to support system development and provide guidance on how to evaluate human-automation-environment system performance without specifying any particular implementation.
